newsitem.title: USA: Deprenyl sets vote on Draxis bid.
newsitem.headline: Deprenyl sets vote on Draxis bid.

text.p: Deprenyl Animal Health Inc said Thursday its shareholders would vote November 26 on a friendly takeover bid made in July by Draxis Health Inc. Draxis holders will vote on November 25.
Under the previously announced offer, Draxis seeks to exchange 1.35 Draxis shares for each outstanding Deprenyl share.
Draxis currently owns 44 percent of Deprenyl. It also holds convertible debt which, if converted, would increase the ownership level to 52 percent.

Deprenyl develops animal health drugs. Draxis is a marketing and research company that operates Canadian neurological and dermatological pharmaceuticals divisions and U.S. consumer marketing company. It also sells products through U.S. podiatrists.
